provenance: Synthetic v4 labels (Tools/coach_training_labels.py). Range/speed: score >= 0.70 with coverage >= 0.75 and low hand error increase both by 3-12% per attempt (half below 0.9 coverage); poor attempts and large errors ease as before (up to -45% range, -35% speed). Start follow: 0 under 2.5 cm, 0.6 from 6 cm, up to 0.8 with large hand error; the start offset does not change range or speed. Not clinically validated.
